title: Season and mini-map covers

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Use repetition as an identity device, because familiar typographic rhythm can connect different publications without the same image.
strategic_value: Alternating colored words on dark covers can carry the Museum’s energetic palette into practical visitor print.
demonstration: Two tall covers repeat cropped AW2023 and MINIMAP text in colored horizontal lines on dark backgrounds.
practical_value: Compare repeated type as a cover image with conventional small informational typography.

content_islands.name: Season cover
content_islands.spec: Fill the left tall cover with large cropped AW2023 text in alternating blue, cyan and muted tones.

content_islands.name: Map cover
content_islands.spec: Fill the right cover with repeated MINIMAP in pink, red and pale tones.

content_islands.name: Pair
content_islands.spec: Place the two narrow publications side by side with their binding details visible.

reference_purposes.Expression: Two tall covers repeat cropped AW2023 and MINIMAP text in colored horizontal lines on dark backgrounds.
